title: Release finished slot work before writing the next task
description: Use a private authenticated gateway and temporary Git remotes to prove cleanup ordering, task survival and release refusals. No live farm slot or worker. Includes automatic selection of published, merged and ownerless stale checkouts before any human picker.

ordering.intent: Release pushed or merged finished work before claim and task creation; preserve new task bytes through prepare and refuse unpublished or successor-owned work.
